uncertain.why: Only one kasra is printed under the vertical ta-ha ligature of الفاتحين; it sits under the ta, so the kasra on ha seems omitted. Two exactly overlapping kasras cannot be fully ruled out (then الفَاتِحِينَ).
Only one kasra is printed under the vertical lam-mim ligature of الظالمين, nearer the lam stroke, so the kasra on mim seems omitted. Overlapping kasras cannot be fully ruled out (then الظَّالِمِينَ).

print_errors.note: The print has a clear space between the conjunction و and الحمد (gap as wide as a normal word space). Kept as printed.

No kasra under the final mim of الأوهام, although the rest of the word is fully vowelled. Kept as printed.
The kasra under fa is printed but the kasra under ra is not (compare النَّاصِرِينَ, الرَّاحِمِينَ, الرَّازِقِينَ). Kept as printed.
شَيءٍ has no sukun on ya (p.083 prints شَيْءٍ), and قَدِير has no tanween. Kept as printed.

notes: p.081 is not a continuation: p.080 ends with a complete Quran quotation and its reference. Items ١–٧ of المسبعات العشر (including «٦- آية الكرسي» and «٧- الباقيات الصالحات») are written as bold paragraphs, following STRUCTURE's «numbered list (bold)», not as ### headings. «الصلاة الإبراهيمية» is ### per STRUCTURE. The spacing after the hyphen is kept as printed: «١-سورة» to «٤-سورة» have none, while «٥- سورة» and «٦- آية» have a space. The subtitle lines under the titles («(تقرأ يوميا …)», «(يقرأ مرَّة يوميًّا منفردًا)», «يقرأ في جماعة …») are plain paragraphs per STRUCTURE, though printed bold. The «(سبع مرات)» at the end of a line, separated by a wide gap, is bold and kept in the same paragraph. On p.083 the calligraphic basmala is written in its standard form outside the brackets. «كٓهيعٓصٓ» on p.083 and «طسٓ-حمٓ- عٓسٓقٓ» on p.084 are in the ordinary font with no ﴿﴾, so they are ordinary text with their printed maddas (U+0653). The dash spacing «طسٓ-حمٓ- عٓسٓقٓ» was measured from pixel gaps. «[طه:١١١]» is printed with no space after the colon. The fathatan on a lam-alif ligature is written after the alif («زِلْزَالاً», «عاجلاً وآجلاً»), because the print cannot show which letter carries it. «وَزُلْزِلُواْ» has a printed sukun on the alif. In the dua text the qamari lam usually has no sukun (e.g. «لِلقُلُوبِ», «المُؤْمِنُونَ», «الحَسْبُ»), except «فِي الْعَالَمِينَ» on p.082, which has one. The lam-alif in «السَّلامَةِ», «فَلا» and «وَلا» has no fatha, as printed. p.084 is a continuation (+) of the كهيعص paragraph. «شَاهَتِ الوُجُوهُ (ثلاثًا).» is not indented and follows a nearly full line, so it is kept in the same paragraph as the Yasin passage. The Quran quotation of al-Rahman 19–20 runs onto p.085: per the earlier keyB practice (b18), it is closed with ﴾ after «بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ» at the end of p.084, so p.085 should reopen with ﴿.
